method.value: Simultaneous single 2D Gaussian per disk fit; radii from HWHM, inclination from axis ratio, PA from deconvolved parameters

evidence.quote: We used CASA’s IMFIT tool to fit both CS disks simultaneously using a single 2D Gaussian for each disk.
We estimated the disks radii from the half-width half-maximum assuming a distance to the system of 147 $\pm$ 5 pc.

analysis_steps.goal: Subtract disks and characterise CB ring

method.value: Subtract four fitted Gaussians (two per disk), fit an ellipse to pixels above 12 sigma in the residuals

evidence.quote: We estimated the radius, inclination and position angle of the extended emission by fitting an ellipse to all pixels above 12$\sigma$ in the residual images.
fitting an ellipse to all pixels above 12$\sigma$ in the residual images

method.value: Deproject the residuals, azimuthally average, fit a 1D Gaussian to the peak, deconvolve by the beam

evidence.quote: We estimated the width of the ring by fitting a 1D Gaussian to the peak of the radial profiles and deconvolved them by their respective beams.

method.value: Integrate flux in Gaussians (CS disks) and in an elliptical annulus on residuals (ring, 46-285 au); alpha from visibility amplitudes of the two continuum spws

evidence.quote: an elliptical annulus aperture with inner radius of 46 au and outer radius of 285 au with an inclination angle of 45$^\circ$ and a position angle of 161$^\circ$

claims.hypothesis: Are the CS disks resolved and how massive?
claims.experiment: 2D Gaussian fits and dust mass formula
claims.result: Disks are marginally resolved with radii ~9-14 au and mass lower limits ~4-6e-3 Msun
claims.finding: Disks are compact and probably optically thick, so masses are lower limits

evidence.quote: We found that both disks are marginally resolved and their estimated radii indicate that both CS disks are fairly compact.

claims.hypothesis: Do geometric effects explain the CB ring brightness asymmetries?
claims.experiment: RADMC-3D model plus MCMC compared to residuals
claims.result: Model reproduces much of the structure; some residuals remain
claims.finding: The ring is mostly axisymmetric with small dust density enhancements

evidence.quote: From our radiative transfer modeling, the CB ring appears to be mostly axisymmetric with a smooth surface density.

limitations_admitted.value: CS disks unresolved internally; jets and disk emission cannot be separated; spectral index uncertain

evidence.quote: due to the beam size of our observations we are not able to clearly disentangle the emission from the CS disks and possible contribution from the jets
